trigger_chain: 1. POS cashier clicks 'Ticket client' button in ReceiptComponent modal (line 41-44).
2. handlePrintClientClick (L532-583) sets isPrinting=true, awaits POST admin/pos/orders/{id}/print-receipt.

3. PosReceiptPrintController::increment performs atomic DB UPDATE (receipt_print_count +=1, branch-scoped at L43-48), reads back fresh count, emits audit_logs row via AuditLogService (hash-chained). Returns JSON {receipt_print_count, is_duplicata, audit_emitted}.
4. UI updates localPrintCount. If audit_emitted=false, alertService.warning('pos.receipt_audit_chain_warning') — print proceeds anyway (operational continuity per W9.B contract).

5. await this.$nextTick(); trigger.click() on the hidden v-print button → vue3-print-nb opens a hidden iframe with the #print-receipt-client DOM cloned, then calls iframe.contentWindow.print() which spawns the OS print dialog.
6. Cashier selects printer + clicks Print in the OS dialog (1 manual click per receipt). No success/failure callback returns to the app.
7. Final fallback: if hiddenPrintClientButton ref unavailable, window.print() is called directly (L578).
browser_print_path.kitchen_path: Identical structure (handlePrintKitchenClick L587-603) but NO API call — kitchen ticket is non-fiscal, no increment, no audit. Renders #print-receipt-kitchen with full instructions + addons + extras.

operational_friction.per_receipt_clicks: 1 cashier click (POS button) + 1 OS-dialog click (Print confirm) = 2 clicks per receipt MINIMUM. macOS / Windows can be configured for 'Always use this printer + skip dialog' but this is OS-level and per-user — not enforceable from the web app.
operational_friction.no_success_callback: window.print() is fire-and-forget. App has zero observability on paper-out / printer-offline / out-of-paper / cover-open.
operational_friction.browser_print_dialog_modal: window.print() BLOCKS the browser tab synchronously until the dialog closes. During that time, no other UI interaction in that tab (cart edit, next order start) can occur.
operational_friction.queued_prints: If cashier triggers 5 prints back-to-back, the browser queues 5 dialog confirmations sequentially. There is NO web standard for batched / silent print queueing. Some browsers may merge into a single 'multi-document' job; behavior is undefined and printer-driver-dependent.

browser_print_path.kiosk_path_separate: Kiosk uses a DIFFERENT printer cascade: KioskConfirmationComponent.vue L380-415 calls resources/js/helpers/kioskPrinter.js → kioskHardware.printReceipt (Electron IPC) → falls back to printEscPos with locally-built ESC/POS lines → ultimate fallback window.print(). When running under Electron (real kiosk), bypasses browser entirely. In dev / browser, falls through to window.print like POS.

edge_cases.scenario: Printer disconnected (cable yanked between job submissions)
edge_cases.browser_path_behavior: window.print() opens dialog. Cashier selects printer that OS still lists as 'available' (cached). OS spooler queues the job. Spooler error surfaces in OS notification only — app sees nothing. receipt_print_count + audit row already advanced.
edge_cases.escpos_path_behavior_if_wired: TcpPrinterTransport::send: @fsockopen returns false within 2.0s timeout → lastError='tcp_open_failed:...' → sendRaw returns false → caller can re-queue / surface alert. Net: ESC/POS direct gives the app real-time failure visibility browser path cannot.
edge_cases.current_mitigation: G5-F-004 (P2) noted. Cashier observes missing paper, retries → second POST → DUPLICATA stamp on first physical paper customer receives. Audit chain integrity preserved; semantic clarity degraded.

edge_cases.browser_path_behavior: Identical to EC-01. window.print has no paper-status callback.
edge_cases.escpos_path_behavior_if_wired: Pure TCP fwrite does NOT detect paper-out either (transport layer success != device acceptance). To detect, need DLE EOT n=4 query before/after job, response parse. Currently TcpPrinterTransport does not implement queries (one-way fwrite + close).
edge_cases.verdict_current: ATTEST G5-F-004 P2 — note: even ESC/POS-day migration requires extending the transport with bi-directional query support, not just adding a printReceipt method.

edge_cases.scenario: Multiple receipts queued under rush (DUPLICATA + new sale + REMBOURSEMENT)
edge_cases.browser_path_behavior: Each ReceiptComponent invocation triggers its own modal lifecycle. POS cannot show 2 receipt modals simultaneously (single #receiptModal DOM id). Cashier must close one before opening next. v-print spawns a separate hidden iframe per click — those iframes can stack in DOM but only the latest window.print call is visible to the user as a dialog. Net effect: serialized at the UI gate, not a true queue.
edge_cases.escpos_path_behavior_if_wired: Direct fsockopen + fwrite is synchronous. Two concurrent calls to sendRaw on the same Printer row would race the socket open. Need either (a) a per-printer Cache::lock similar to FiscalSequenceService, or (b) a queued spool job. Mitigation: model the print spool as a Laravel queue (low) with per-printer mutex.
edge_cases.verdict_current: GREEN at UI gate (single modal serialization). Future ESC/POS migration MUST add per-printer mutex to avoid socket race.

edge_cases.browser_path_behavior: ReceiptComponent.vue:432 hardcodes paperWidthMm=58. CSS media-print rules (L628-632) clamp width: 58mm. Receipt prints at 58mm regardless of actual installed printer width. On an 80mm printer, the paper is over-wide and content sits in the left ~58mm strip.
edge_cases.escpos_path_behavior_if_wired: Printer.width_chars field exists (default 48 per PrinterServiceTest.printerData = 80mm). EscPosCommandBuilder::lineKV/separator/centerLine accept widthChars param. testPrint correctly reads $printer->width_chars ?: 48. NEW printReceipt method MUST read printer->width_chars and adapt — and DOM ReceiptComponent must align (58mm=32chars, 80mm=48chars).
edge_cases.verdict_current: NEW DELTA — paperWidthMm hardcoded 58 in ReceiptComponent is a strategic discrepancy vs Printer.width_chars model field. Currently masked because (a) Le Cayenne LOCAL dev DB has ZERO printer rows (`DB::table('printers')->get()` returned `[]` 2026-05-24) and (b) print path is browser-driven (CSS clamp). Surfaces immediately when ESC/POS path is wired. See L1.2-F-01.

edge_cases.scenario: Two divergent ESC/POS code paths (PHP backend + JS kiosk Electron)
edge_cases.observation: PHP EscPosCommandBuilder (app/Services/Hardware/EscPosCommandBuilder.php) and JS kioskPrinter.js (resources/js/helpers/kioskPrinter.js) BOTH build ESC/POS byte streams independently. Different default width (PHP defaults to 48 / 80mm, JS RECEIPT_WIDTH=32 / 58mm), different command tables (PHP doubleSize uses GS!\x11 / 'normal+wider+taller', JS DOUBLE_SIZE uses ESC!\x30 / 'double width + double height'), different sanitization (PHP strips control chars only, JS no sanitization). NF525 customer-ticket parity not enforced across surfaces.
edge_cases.verdict_current: NEW DELTA — strategic choice for ESC/POS-day: converge on one builder (recommended: PHP server-side, since fiscal/audit lives backend), retire JS builder. See L1.2-F-02.

must_include_in_printReceipt: Header: company_name + branch.address + branch.phone + SIRET + VAT intra + register_id + operator name (NF525 §V identification)
Order metadata: order_serial_no + order_date + order_time + queue_number (or token)

Composition: EVERY composition_snapshot line — item_variations (lines), item_extras (extras), AND item_addons (composer-driven menu_formule + bowl meat/sauce). G5-F-002 attests addons silently dropped on current HTML receipt — ESC/POS migration MUST not perpetuate.
Fiscal totals: subtotal_without_tax + each tax_lines entry (tax_name + tax_rate + base_ht + tax_amount) + discount + delivery_charge (if DELIVERY) + grand total
Payment breakdown: per-tranche method label + amount + change (cash) — currently buildPaymentsBreakdown via posReceiptBuilder.js
DUPLICATA marker if receipt_print_count >= 2 (Wave Q-3 wired client-side)
REMBOURSEMENT marker if parent_order_id > 0 (G5-F-001 attests parent_order_id NOT exposed by OrderDetailsResource — dead UI; ESC/POS migration MUST require G5-F-001 heal first)
NF525 footer: fiscal_sequence_no + audit_chain_signature + Z-report ref (nf525FooterLines in current template)

FR canonical currency `12,50 €` (comma + nbsp + €). G5-F-003 attests current HTML prints `12.50€` (period, no nbsp) — divergence with PaymentComponent. ESC/POS migration MUST canonicalize at the same call site (use AppLibrary heal path A — SSOT) so all surfaces converge.
nf525_compliance_via_escpos_when_wired.duplicata_status: GREEN — ReceiptDuplicataMarker.vue + receipt_print_count + audit_logs.action='pos.receipt.reprint' all wired (Wave Q-3). Re-print is the cashier-driven re-render of the same #receiptModal. ESC/POS migration: pass same flag to printReceipt(order, ['duplicata' => $count>=2]).
nf525_compliance_via_escpos_when_wired.remboursement_status: RED (ATTEST G5-F-001 P0) — UI marker present but parent_order_id field NEVER serialized by OrderDetailsResource. ESC/POS migration is BLOCKED on G5-F-001 heal landing first (otherwise refunds print as normal sales on thermal hardware too).
nf525_compliance_via_escpos_when_wired.reproducibility: GREEN — receipt_print_count is the ledger of how many times receipt was issued. Re-print from PosOrdersTrackerComponent (button :data-testid=`tracker-reprint-${order.id}`) fetches full order via /admin/pos/orders/{id} and re-opens #receiptModal. Same data, regenerated DOM. Customer can request re-print anytime (NF525 Article 286-I-3 bis evidence preservation).

print_queue_under_load.scenario: 5 simultaneous prints during rush (1 client receipt + 1 kitchen ticket + 1 reprint + 1 refund REMBOURSEMENT + 1 cash-drawer kick)
print_queue_under_load.browser_path: window.print() is synchronous-modal-per-call. 5 prints = 5 OS dialog confirmations serially (assuming default browser behavior; no batched print API). Cashier physically clicks Print 5 times. Time cost: ~3-5s per dialog × 5 = 15-25s of cashier attention. During this window, the POS tab is BLOCKED — no cart edits, no next-order start. CRITICAL OPERATIONAL FRICTION.
print_queue_under_load.escpos_path_if_wired: 5 calls to sendRaw within ms of each other → 5 sequential fsockopen calls on potentially the same printer host. Without a per-printer mutex, the second fsockopen could race the first if the printer accepts only one TCP connection (most ESC/POS printers do). Mitigation: add Cache::lock('printer:'.$printer->id, 5) wrapper around sendRaw, OR push to a low queue with a per-printer worker.
print_queue_under_load.verdict: Browser path: AMBER operational friction (1+OS click per receipt × N). ESC/POS-day MUST add per-printer mutex; otherwise socket race possible.
print_queue_under_load.v1_local_acceptable: Yes — Le Cayenne single-box, single cashier station, rush probably <5 simultaneous receipts per minute. Operational friction is tolerable. NOT acceptable for V2 SaaS multi-station rush.

blocking_prereqs: G5-F-001 heal: OrderDetailsResource MUST expose parent_order_id + parent_order_serial_no for REMBOURSEMENT marker to fire (PHP path or HTML path equally affected).
G5-F-002 heal: composition_snapshot.addons MUST be rendered on receipt (NF525 §V). Both HTML and ESC/POS paths need a single source of truth — see L1.2-F-03 below.
G5-F-003 heal: AppLibrary::currencyAmountFormat to emit `12,50 €` canonical (Path A SSOT recommended). All surfaces converge.

H6-F-002 heal: EscPosCommandBuilder textLine/centerLine/lineKV MUST call encodeForPrinter() before sanitize(). Currently latent because the ESC/POS receipt path is dead; activates the moment printReceipt() lands.
checklist_when_owner_branches_printer: STEP 1: Verify above 4 prereqs landed and have green sentinels (G5-F-001 ResourceTest, G5-F-002 Vitest mount, G5-F-003 PHPUnit currency assert, H6-F-002 ::textLineForTest assert).

STEP 2: Add EscPosPrinterService::printReceipt(Order $order, array $options = []): array. Renders header → composition (variations + extras + addons) → totals → payments → DUPLICATA flag → REMBOURSEMENT flag → NF525 footer → feed(3) → cut. Returns {success, error?, bytes_sent}.
STEP 3: Add EscPosPrinterService::printKitchenTicket(Order $order, ?string $station = null) for kitchen-station-specific tickets (mirror current HTML kitchen template).

STEP 4: Replace ReceiptComponent.handlePrintClientClick chain: instead of POST→DB-increment→window.print(), invert to POST→backend-calls-printReceipt→IF success THEN increment+audit. Fixes G5-F-004 P2 semantic over-count.

STEP 5: Per-printer width: read $printer->width_chars in printReceipt (32 for 58mm, 48 for 80mm). DOM ReceiptComponent paperWidthMm computed from same width_chars (32→58mm, 48→80mm). Single source of truth.
STEP 6: Per-printer code_page from $printer->options['code_page'] (already in model; default 19 / CP858).
STEP 7: Wrap EscPosPrinterService::sendRaw in Cache::lock('printer:'.$printer->id, 5)->block(3) to serialize concurrent prints on same socket.

STEP 8: Extend TcpPrinterTransport with queryStatus(Printer) → DLE EOT n=4 (paper status) parse response → surface to admin diagnostic ('Paper LOW' / 'Cover OPEN' / 'OK'). Optional V1.0.1; nice-to-have V1.
STEP 9: Wire CASH payment success → automatic drawer kick (EscPosPrinterService::openDrawer already wired and callable from PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment).

STEP 10: Mock simulator for tests = NullPrinterTransport (ALREADY EXISTS — capture bytes for assertions, see PrinterServiceTest.test_test_print_returns_true_and_captures_escpos_payload). No new infra needed.
STEP 11: Idempotency middleware on /print-receipt route is ALREADY wired (routes/api.php:881). Preserve.

STEP 12: Decision: deprecate resources/js/helpers/kioskPrinter.js JS ESC/POS builder OR keep for Electron-bridge kiosk path. Recommend KEEP for kiosk (Electron-native printer direct via window.borne.printEscPos is faster than backend-roundtrip), but ENFORCE feature-parity tests between PHP and JS builders to prevent silent divergence (NEW Vitest+PHPUnit twin sentinel).
migration_path_to_escpos.rollback_plan: If printReceipt fails in production, the existing browser-print path remains intact. Add a feature flag config('printing.use_escpos_direct', false). When false, fall through to current vue3-print-nb + window.print. Toggle-able without code redeploy. Safe staged rollout: Le Cayenne dev printer → 1 day soak → Le Cayenne live.

findings.title: Two divergent ESC/POS builders (PHP EscPosCommandBuilder + JS kioskPrinter.js) — silent drift risk
findings.evidence: PHP EscPosCommandBuilder.php (backend, used by testPrint + openDrawer): default width 48, sanitize strips control chars only, doubleSize emits GS!\x11, CUT = GS V\x00. JS kioskPrinter.js (kiosk Electron bridge): RECEIPT_WIDTH=32, no sanitization, DOUBLE_SIZE = ESC!\x30, CUT = GS V\x00. Both targeting same family of ESC/POS thermal printers but no parity tests, no shared contract.
findings.current_blast_radius: ZERO — kiosk uses Electron-direct path (window.borne.printEscPos) which only runs on real kiosk hardware; POS uses browser HTML path. No customer sees both surfaces today.
findings.activation_trigger: If owner unifies receipt path through PHP backend (recommended in migration checklist STEP 12), JS builder becomes dead code OR remains for Electron-kiosk-only with documented divergence. If both stay live, every receipt format tweak must land in BOTH places (drift surface).
findings.heal_recommendation: ESC/POS-day decision: (A) Keep JS for kiosk Electron path (faster IPC), add a twin-sentinel test that snapshots PHP-emitted bytes vs JS-emitted bytes for the same logical receipt fixture and asserts byte-equivalence. (B) Send kiosk receipts through backend printReceipt API (slower but converges to ONE builder). Recommend (A) for V1 (preserves kiosk speed) + (B) as V2 SaaS direction. V1.0.2 backlog.
findings.phase_l_impact: Strategic flag for owner; not a code change needed today.

findings.title: TcpPrinterTransport is one-way (fwrite + close) — cannot query device status, cannot detect paper-out / cover-open even with ESC/POS
findings.evidence: TcpPrinterTransport.php L24-43: @fsockopen 2.0s timeout → stream_set_timeout 2s → @fwrite → @fclose. Returns true if all bytes written. ZERO response read. ESC/POS DLE EOT (real-time status query, n=1/2/3/4 for printer/offline/error/paper status) is NOT implemented.
findings.current_blast_radius: ZERO — receipt path is browser-driven, transport unused for receipts. Only testPrint + openDrawer use it. Both are one-way commands.
findings.activation_trigger: Once printReceipt() lands and ops want admin observability ('Le Cayenne KDS station printer paper LOW'), the transport must be extended with bi-directional query support: open socket → fwrite DLE EOT n=4 → fread 1 byte → parse bit-mask → return ['paper'=>'low|out|ok', 'cover'=>'open|closed', 'offline'=>bool].
findings.heal_recommendation: V1.0.2 backlog: extend PrinterTransportInterface with `query(string $command, array $config, int $timeoutMs = 1000): ?string`. TcpPrinterTransport implements via fsockopen + fwrite + fread. NullPrinterTransport returns canned values for tests. EscPosPrinterService::queryStatus(Printer) wraps with DLE EOT semantics. Wire into SyncOverviewController dashboard (alongside ws:heartbeat from K1-F-02) for live printer-health.
findings.phase_l_impact: Defer to V1.0.2. V1 LOCAL acceptable to rely on cashier visual confirmation.

top_3_printer_concerns: 1. P0 BLOCKING ESC/POS MIGRATION: G5-F-001 — OrderDetailsResource does NOT expose parent_order_id, so REMBOURSEMENT marker (HTML and future ESC/POS) cannot render on refund-counter-entry receipts. F2-HEAL-03 NF525 visual distinction is non-functional. Must heal before either (a) live operation under refunds OR (b) ESC/POS-day migration.

2. P1 SEMANTIC: G5-F-003 — receipt prints `12.50€` while PaymentComponent shows `12,50 €` canonical FR format. Same caisse, two formats. ESC/POS migration is the perfect forcing function to converge via AppLibrary Path A (SSOT). Fiscal auditor flag risk + customer perception risk. V1.0.1.

3. P2 LATENT MIGRATION-DAY TRAP: H6-F-002 — EscPosCommandBuilder::encodeForPrinter (CP858 iconv TRANSLIT) is defined but ZERO callers. textLine/centerLine/lineKV pass UTF-8 directly. The moment owner branches a real thermal printer AND owner wires printReceipt() through the existing builders, every accented item name (`Suppléments`, `Bol Mariné`, `Algérienne`) will print as `Ã©` mojibake on customer tickets. Pre-empt by wiring encodeForPrinter into the three text methods BEFORE the migration lands.
